# ResumeBuddy & AI Resume Builder - Full Documentation

> Complete catalog of features, templates, and agentic integrations for ResumeBuddy.

ResumeBuddy is an AI-powered resume optimization and developer portfolio platform.

## Features

- **Resume Parsing & Optimization**: Deterministic ATS-compatible resume analysis.
- **Developer Portfolio Generator**: Customizable interactive portfolio websites.
- **Export Engine**: Vector-grade PDF generation and native Word (.docx) export.

## Templates

- [Kinetic Editorial](https://ai-resume-builder-client-three.vercel.app/portfolio-templates/editorial): High-impact interactive editorial design.
- [Spotlight](https://ai-resume-builder-client-three.vercel.app/portfolio-templates/spotlight): Modern developer showcase with light/dark contrast.
- [Poster](https://ai-resume-builder-client-three.vercel.app/portfolio-templates/poster): Bold typography and graphic cards.
- [One-Page Résumé](https://ai-resume-builder-client-three.vercel.app/portfolio-templates/one-page): Minimalist single-page technical resume.
